name: agent-manager.conversation-recall
purpose: Recover retained Agent Manager conversations from incomplete clues by merging bounded direct and federated searches, then optionally fetching bounded context.

clues.description: One to three partial-memory clues. Empty strings are rejected; raw clues are not echoed in the envelope.

project_scope.description: Optional exact Agent Manager project-scope filter for direct search.

harness.description: Optional exact harness filter for direct search.

role.description: Optional exact message-role filter for direct search.

occurred_after.description: Optional RFC3339 lower time bound for direct search.

occurred_before.description: Optional RFC3339 upper time bound for direct search.

policy.description: Which authoritative search surfaces to call.

per_query_limit.description: Results requested per search leg; range 1 through 10.

context_candidates.description: Top candidates expanded only in context output mode; range 0 through 3.

context_before.description: Events before each selected hit; range 0 through 5.

context_after.description: Events after each selected hit; range 0 through 5.

max_context_bytes.description: Aggregate UTF-8 bytes retained from snippets and context; range 0 through 12000.

output_mode.description: Metadata omits all content, snippets adds bounded hit snippets, and context adds bounded neighboring event content.

assumptions: Agent Manager is running and exposes a policy-filtered retained conversation projection
Search Hub is required only for federated or both policy
the caller is authorized to see any content requested by output_mode
each invocation runs in a fresh Program Runtime session
invariants: only declared read bindings are called; canonical runs, projections, configurations, corpora, and memory are never changed
at most four deterministic query variants, twelve search calls, three context calls, twenty candidates, and twelve thousand content bytes are retained
provider ranking is preserved as contributing evidence; the program only deduplicates identities and orders by support count then best native rank
raw clues are never echoed in output, evidence, errors, or telemetry
one failed search leg preserves every successful leg and produces partial status
the envelope is printed exactly once on every path

signals.query_variants: Number of deduplicated deterministic variants; clue text is omitted.
signals.legs_planned: Bounded direct and federated calls planned.
signals.legs_succeeded: Search calls that returned a governed response.
signals.legs_failed: Search calls that failed, with one classified error each.
signals.candidate_count: Deduplicated attributable Agent Manager candidates returned.
signals.candidates: Ranked bounded metadata, optional content, provenance, contributing surface/mode/rank evidence, and optional context.
signals.sibling_provider_count: Federated hits owned by other providers; these are counted but their content is not copied.
signals.degradations: Deduplicated reason, leg, and retryability only; raw provider details are omitted.
signals.next_actions: Closed next steps derived from no-result, ambiguity, partial-leg, and degradation states.
signals.content_bytes: Aggregate UTF-8 bytes of optional snippets and context retained in the envelope.

outputs.evidence: Binding IDs plus query ordinal, mode, counts, stable hit IDs, and degradation categories; never clue or conversation content.

fixtures.note: An empty live corpus is a valid ok result; deterministic fixture assertions live in Agent Manager tests.
